description: Dian Wei, massive bare-armed chinese warrior in the supplied pixel art style. Black hair in a topknot, a blue headband with long tails, a dark studded leather harness over a bare muscular torso, a blue sash, dark trousers and boots. He holds a short crescent-bladed halberd in each hand
face: Fierce scowling eyes and a rough black beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the black topknot, the blue headband tails, the bare muscular back under the dark harness, the blue sash, a short halberd at each side.
guard_action: both hands lift their weapons up in front of the body, the left foot steps forward and the knees bend

actions.idle: Twin-weapon fighting guard, one weapon in each hand, breathing
actions.move: Seamless combat run in place with a weapon in each hand, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.b1: Two cuts, right then left. Frames 1-5 wind up; frame 7 the right weapon cuts; frame 9 the left weapon cuts; frames 10-11 follow through. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The twin short halberds stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a2: Rising right-hand cut, left weapon blocking low. Frames 1-5 the right weapon drops low; frame 8 it cuts upward while the left weapon guards low; frames 9-11 finish high. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The twin short halberds stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a3: Crossing cut with both weapons. Frames 1-5 both arms open wide; frame 8 both weapons cut inward and cross in front of the body; frames 9-11 hold crossed. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The twin short halberds stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s2: Ferocious challenge. Frames 1-6 he sinks low with both weapons pulled in; frame 8 he bursts upright throwing both weapons out wide with the chest forward; frames 9-12 hold. Nothing is struck. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The twin short halberds stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 b1 → a2 → a3, 전법 s2. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정.
